fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ClientInstanceId
fields.about: Assigned client instance id if request ClientInstanceId was all zeros, else echoes request value.

fields.name: SubscriptionId
fields.about: Unique identifier for the current config subscription.

fields.name: ConfigMaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes of config data the broker accepts in PushConfigRequest.

fields.name: RequestedKeys
fields.about: The config keys the broker wants to receive.

fields.name: Name
fields.about: The config key name. May be '*' for all keys.
